programs.title: Anaconda
programs.desc: Best friends Griff and Doug have always dreamed of remaking their all-time favorite movie "Anaconda." When a midlife crisis pushes them to finally go for it, they assemble a crew and head deep into the jungles of the Amazon to start filming. However, life soon imitates art when a monstrous anaconda with a thirst for blood starts hunting them down one by one.

programs.title: Anatomy of a Fall
programs.desc: A woman is suspected of her husband's murder, and their blind son faces a moral dilemma as the sole witness.

programs.title: Whistle
programs.desc: Terror strikes when a group of misfit high-school students discovers an ancient death whistle.

programs.title: The Long Walk
programs.desc: Teens participate in a grueling high-stakes contest where they must continuously walk or be shot by a member of their military escort.

programs.title: O'Dessa
programs.desc: A farm girl embarks on an epic quest to recover a cherished family heirloom in the post-apocalyptic future. Her journey soon leads her to a strange and dangerous city where she meets her one true love. However, in order to save his soul, she must put the power of destiny and music to the ultimate test.

programs.title: Women Who Rock
programs.desc: As questions of authenticity, control, and feminism arise in the '90s, Sheryl Crow, Missy Elliott, Courtney Love, Tori Amos, and Alanis Morissette make music on their own terms.
